services.name: Miami Celebrity Homes Cruise
services.desc: Miami has been home to many rich, famous and infamous people, who like most of us, wanted to live with an ocean view and wonderful sea breezes. People like Elizabeth Taylor, Lebron James, Gloria Estefan, Jackie Chan, Dwayne Wade, Julio Iglesias, Oprah Winfrey, Tom Cruise, Enrique Iglesias, Cristina, and many more. They have built numerous beautiful and opulent mansions on our shores and islands. While you can’t get near most of these homes by car come join us on one of our Celebrity Homes Tours and get an up close view of many of these beautiful homes, sip a Pina Colada while you enjoy spectacular views of Miami, South Beach, and the Port of Miami. services.name: New Year's Fireworks Cruise aboard Fiesta I
services.desc: NEW YEARS EVE HOLIDAY FIREWORKS CRUISE - Enjoy the fireworks as only Miami can, on the water, with the best view in town! Our vessel, Fiesta I, has the only totally open upper deck in Bayside Marketplace, for completely unobstructed views, as well as multiple unobstructed views from the lower deck as well! services.desc: NEW YEARS EVE HOLIDAY FIREWORKS CRUISE – Kick out 2023 in style, the Miami Way. quotes.author: PaulV
quotes.text: Very scenic. Great for picture taking Very scenic cruise. Great views of the mansions on Star Island and the city. We were able to view the city go from daylight to night during the cruise. The guide would recite something in English and then repeat it in Spanish. The 7:00 PM cruise starts loading at 6:45 PM so you should be ready to line up at 6:30 PM. You want to be on the top level of the boat. You will want to pick up your ticket from the booth by 6:15 PM. I would also recommend having a long sleeve shirt or light jacket as may be cooler on the water.

quotes.author: Andrea DeJesus
quotes.text: Found a Sunset Miami Skyline Boat Tour with open bar activity off of Groupon. A great experience. The open bar included frozen drinks, drink sizes were large, and there wasn’t any skimping out on the liquor. All the staff were friendly. Our tour guide was entertaining, we got to see a lot of celebrity homes, and we watched the sunset. I’d definitely recommend. Parking was a little tricky. Taking an Uber worked out the best for us. The pier also has bars, restaurants, and shops.

quotes.author: Alana
quotes.text: Very nice! We parked at College Station parking (a 10 minute walk for $10 for 0-4 hrs). Before the tour we saw many huge fish & a very precious manatee drinking water from a hose right by the Victoria Secret & the half day fishing tour boat (by the ticket booth)! We saw a dolphin when we were pulling out! You can view all the beauty surrounding you & relax & take it all in!

quotes.author: Stephen W
quotes.text: Good views, good drinks. Good views. We think a few more highlights of what you’re seeing could be pointed out. Nice drinks. Staff fairly friendly for the most part.
